theme: An open day, one week out from Croatia.
greeting: Just one thing on the calendar today, Dan — the NACD New England call at noon — so the morning is yours. With Croatia a week out, this is the day to close the overdue bookings before you're offline on the water.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night and transfer
needsAttention.detail: Overdue P1. The last night after the charter (Sat Sept 19) plus the noon Komolac→Cavtat transfer have to be booked from shore before you fly Sept 8 — the boat has no connectivity. Book refundable.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: Overdue P1. The issued ticket shows 0 checked bags on Eurowings Discover. Verify on the operating carrier's site with the record locator and buy bags online now, before airport-counter rates.

needsAttention.title: Book St Pete nights Sept 20–22
needsAttention.detail: Overdue P1. You land TPA Sun Sept 20 from Croatia, but the girls aren't picked up until Tue Sept 22 — the two nights before the Orlando villa are still unbooked.

needsAttention.title: Reply to Conor Kehoe on the PRI
needsAttention.detail: He thought he'd lost your July note and copied his assistant Kate to set a time — a stewardship conversation worth reopening while you're between roles.

needsAttention.title: Build the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: Due yesterday. Pack the car tote before the Sept 3 house move so the first migration is a test run with time to fix what breaks.

schedule.title: NACD New England – intro call
schedule.detail: Zoom with Larissa Ravetto, Ellen Richstone and Deb Rosenthal

flagged.title: Conor Kehoe — PRI stewardship chat
flagged.detail: His assistant Kate will organize a time; a reply reopens it.

flagged.title: Nautilus Sailing charter paid
flagged.detail: $6,475 to Nautilus Sailing confirmed — the Croatia charter.

flagged.title: New sitter applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Maleah S. responded to your job posting.

inbox.noise: The rest is routine — a QuickBooks payment-method notice and your daily Japanese lesson.

recipe.title: Onion Tart
recipe.why: Autumn's onions turn sweet and mellow with a slow bake, right for the turn of the season.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: A clear stretch before noon — the best window this week to knock out the overdue Croatia bookings.
The NACD New England call at noon, then the day reopens.
The girls are in the house in St. Pete; an onion tart is a good slow-oven anchor for the night.
